candidate.bug_signature: HTTPResponse caches partial content when read(amt=None) is called after a partial read
candidate.repro_summary: Make a request and get an HTTPResponse. Call read(amt=1) to do a partial read. Then call read(amt=None, cache_content=True) to read the rest of the response and attempt to cache it. The response's cached `_body` will only contain the data from the second read, not the entire response.
candidate.bad_behavior: When HTTPResponse.read() is called with cache_content=True after a previous partial read, it caches only the remaining content instead of refusing to cache or caching the full content.
candidate.expected_behavior: If an uncached partial read has already occurred, a subsequent full read should not cache the remaining fragment as if it were the full body.
candidate.preserved_behavior: Regular full reads with cache_content=True still cache the full response. Uncached full reads still work.
edge_cases: Must track whether an uncached read occurred across multiple read() calls
Must apply to both standard response and emscripten response
